evidence.quote: For any running Kinesis Client Library (KCL) application, a shard only has one owner. However, multiple record processors may temporarily process the same shard.

If a worker instance loses network connectivity, the KCL assumes that the unreachable worker is no longer processing records after the failover time expires, and directs other worker instances to take over. For a brief period, new record processors and record processors from the unreachable worker may process data from the same shard.
